scenes.text: So... is there a rule that says canceling has to be easy?
scenes.head: IS THERE A RULE?

scenes.text: In October 2024, the FTC finalized a click-to-cancel rule. Cancel as easily as you signed up.
scenes.head: OCTOBER 2024
scenes.say: In October twenty twenty-four, the FTC finalized a click-to-cancel rule. Cancel as easily as you signed up.
scenes.show_source: Source: FTC rule (Oct 2024); 8th Circuit decision (July 2025); FTC advance notice (Mar 11, 2026)

scenes.text: Then, in July 2025, a federal appeals court struck it down. Over procedure.
scenes.head: JULY 2025
scenes.say: Then, in July twenty twenty-five, a federal appeals court struck it down. Over procedure.
scenes.show_source: Source: FTC rule (Oct 2024); 8th Circuit decision (July 2025); FTC advance notice (Mar 11, 2026)

scenes.text: And in March 2026, the FTC started over, asking the public for comments.
scenes.head: MARCH 2026
scenes.say: And in March twenty twenty-six, the FTC started over, asking the public for comments.
scenes.show_source: Source: FTC rule (Oct 2024); 8th Circuit decision (July 2025); FTC advance notice (Mar 11, 2026)

scenes.text: Meanwhile, many states have their own auto-renewal laws. So the answer is... it depends where you live.
scenes.head: SO... IS IT LEGAL?

scenes.text: Which brings us back to your number. Remember it?
scenes.head: YOUR NUMBER

scenes.text: So I tried it myself. I opened my wallet app and counted everything I pay for.
scenes.head: BUCK'S EXPERIMENT

scenes.text: Streaming. Cloud storage. A monocle-polishing club...
scenes.head: WAIT. WHAT?

scenes.text: I don't remember joining a monocle-polishing club. I don't even... okay, I have a monocle.
scenes.head: I HAVE A MONOCLE

scenes.text: Relax. I have a plan. I'll cancel it right now.
scenes.head: I HAVE A PLAN

scenes.text: It asked for my password. Then my reason. Then offered me three months half off.
scenes.head: THE MAZE, LIVE

scenes.text: My guess was way lower than my real total. Just like the people in that 2022 survey.
scenes.head: GUESS: TOO LOW
scenes.say: My guess was way lower than my real total. Just like the people in that twenty twenty-two survey.
scenes.show_source: Source: C+R Research subscription survey, reported by CNBC (June 2, 2022)

scenes.text: So here's my question: what's the weirdest subscription you found you were still paying for?
scenes.head: YOUR TURN

scenes.text: Write it in the comments. I'll read them... while my monocle club bills me.
scenes.head: TELL ME BELOW

scenes.text: Buck's bloopers!
scenes.head: BUCK'S BLOOPERS

scenes.text: The Ill... the Illy... the Iliad. Who names a button after a POEM?
scenes.head: TAKE 1

scenes.text: Four point three visits. Four point... hold on. I need to sit down. From the gym.
scenes.head: TAKE 2

scenes.text: Monocle club: cancel! Cancel! ...It's asking if I'm SURE.
scenes.head: TAKE 3

scenes.text: Wait, was it eighty-six or... two hundred... I'm a coin, not a calculator!
scenes.head: TAKE 4

scenes.text: I'm okay! Did my own stunts.
scenes.head: I'M OKAY!
